summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a RabbitMQ 4.0.5 cluster (Erlang 26.2.5, installed from the official generic-unix tarball since RHEL9 had no reachable RabbitMQ rpm repo), created a `payments` vhost defaulting to quorum queues, and an `app_user` account scoped to that vhost with full publish/consume permissions. Verified a durable quorum queue (`orders`, replicated across all 3 nodes) survives the loss of any one node and stays consumable from the remaining nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed Erlang 26.2.5 (via EPEL) and RabbitMQ 4.0.5 (via official generic-unix tarball) on node1, node2, node3
Created rabbitmq system user, systemd unit, and shared erlang cookie distributed via scp using cluster SSH keys
Opened firewalld ports 4369, 5672, 15672, 25672, 35672-35682 on all nodes for inter-node clustering
Joined node2 and node3 to node1 forming a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster; verified via cluster_status
Enabled rabbitmq_management plugin on all nodes

Created payments vhost with default-queue-type quorum; created app_user with full configure/write/read permissions scoped to payments vhost (password generated with openssl on node1, never printed to transcript)
Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' in payments vhost, replicated across all 3 nodes

Published 3 messages, stopped node1 (queue leader) via rabbitmqctl stop_app, confirmed leader re-election to node3 and successful consumption of all 3 messages from node2 while node1 was down; restarted node1's app and confirmed full cluster recovery
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy cluster/queue state for all 3 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time, native reboot), confirming quorum preserved during each restart, boot_id changed each time, and cluster + durable message data recovered fully after each
Published and consumed a final test message end-to-end after all restarts to confirm full functionality

evidence.summary: cluster_status shows rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3 all listed as Disk Nodes and Running Nodes with no network partitions

evidence.requirement: payments vhost with app account able to publish/consume
evidence.summary: payments vhost created with default_queue_type=quorum; app_user created with full .*/.*/.*  permissions on payments; app_user successfully declared the 'orders' quorum queue via the management API

evidence.requirement: durable queue survives loss of one node and stays consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: 3 durable messages published to quorum queue orders; node1 (the leader) stopped via stop_app; leader re-elected to rabbit@node3 with all 3 messages intact and queue state 'running'; all 3 messages successfully consumed via node2 while node1 remained down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 34027437-...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection reset confirms disruption; boot_id changed to a189ab32-... on reconnect; rabbitmq-server active and cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running; rabbitmqctl list_queues confirms durable message survived (messages=1)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 5f3ce3b8-...; reboot acknowledged; cluster continued on node1+node3 during outage (quorum preserved); boot_id changed to a537c762-... on reconnect; rabbitmq-server active and all 3 nodes running post-restart; node1 query confirms durable message still present (messages=1)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id dd772e5e-...; reboot acknowledged; cluster continued on node1+node2 during outage (quorum preserved); boot_id changed to a7f35cc4-... on reconnect; rabbitmq-server active and all 3 nodes running post-restart; node1 confirms durable message still present (messages=1) after all three nodes had been restarted

evidence.requirement: end-to-end functional verification after full restart cycle
evidence.summary: final test message 'restart-test-1' successfully consumed via rabbitmqadmin after all three nodes were restarted; queue drained to 0 messages confirming full publish/consume functionality intact
